question: Who among the following personalities is an awardee of Sahitya Natak Akademi for his contribution to the Chhau dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandra Shekhar Bhanj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chhau dance is a traditional dance form performed by men from Eastern India that enacts episodes from epics including Ramayana and Mahabharata.
 
• Chhau dance can be classified into three divisions based on the place it is performed; Mayurbhanj Chau of Odisha, Seraikella Chau of Jharkhand, and Purulia Chau of Bengal.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The main objective of this dance form is to celebrate martial arts.
 
• Chhau dance is intimately connected to regional festivals, notably the spring festival Chaitra Parva.
 
• While the performers wear amazing masks in Jharkhand and Bengal, the dancers in Odisha don’t necessarily wear one while performing.
 
• Music flows in the form of percussion instruments like ‘Dhol’, ‘Nagara’ and wind instruments like ‘Shehnai’.
 
• Performing Chhau requires tremendous stamina and strength as the energy levels maintained throughout the performance are pretty high.
 
• The dance is performed at night in an open space to traditional and folk melodies, played on the reed pipes mohuri and shehnai*.*
 
• The reverberating drumbeats of a variety of drums dominate the accompanying music ensemble. Chhau is an integral part of the culture of these communities.
 
• It binds together people from different social strata and ethnic backgrounds with diverse social practices, beliefs, professions, and languages.
